hooks.command:
cd "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}" 2>/dev/null; mkdir -p local-feed; git fetch --quiet 2>/dev/null; ctx=$(printf 'git worktrees:
%s

branch:
%s' "$(git worktree list 2>/dev/null)" "$(git status -sb 2>/dev/null | head -1)"); printf '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"SessionStart","additionalContext":%s}}' "$(printf '%s' "$ctx" | jq -Rs .)"

data=$(cat); f=$(printf '%s' "$data" | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // ""'); case "$f" in *.md) c=$(printf '%s' "$data" | jq -r '.tool_input.content // .tool_input.new_string // ""'); printf '%s' "$c" | LC_ALL=C grep -qF -e '—' -e '–' && printf '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"Introduces an em-dash or en-dash. Repo bans them in shipped text. Use a period, comma, colon, or parentheses instead."}}' ;; esac

data=$(cat); cmd=$(printf '%s' "$data" | jq -r '.tool_input.command // ""'); tag=$(printf '%s' "$cmd" | grep -oE 'v[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+' | head -1); [ -z "$tag" ] && exit 0; cd "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}" || exit 0; git fetch --tags --quiet 2>/dev/null; if git rev-parse -q --verify "refs/tags/$tag" >/dev/null 2>&1 || git ls-remote --tags origin "$tag" 2>/dev/null | grep -q "refs/tags/$tag$"; then printf '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"Tag %s already exists (local or origin). A concurrent release likely took it. Re-read the current version and tags, bump to the next free version, rebase the CHANGELOG entry, then tag."}}' "$tag"; fi

data=$(cat); f=$(printf '%s' "$data" | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // ""'); case "$f" in *Directory.Build.props) cd "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}" || exit 0; if git diff HEAD -- Directory.Build.props 2>/dev/null | grep -q 'KhaozEngineVersion' && git diff HEAD --quiet -- CHANGELOG.md 2>/dev/null; then printf '{"systemMessage":"<KhaozEngineVersion> changed but CHANGELOG.md is unmodified. Repo rule: the version bump and CHANGELOG entry go in the same commit."}'; fi ;; esac
